summary: Iteration 2 testing (SSE real-time, avatar uploads, organizer dashboard, milestone moments). Backend: 7/7 pytest passed covering analytics access control (initiator OK, non-initiator 403, unknown 403), avatar upload/attach/serve, member avatar update with device-cookie ownership (200 same-device / 403 different-device), non-image rejection, and SSE stream (initial 'stats' event + 'join' event on live join). Frontend: OrganizerDashboard at /dashboard/j4atawQ7lw renders all 4 analytics stat cards, chart-reach, chart-depth, geo-spread, top-branches, dashboard-back-link. Non-initiator /dashboard/{unknown} shows 'not authorized'. /me/j4atawQ7lw shows organizer-dashboard-link; /me for freshly-joined member did not (verified via existence-only check on initiator page). Milestone badges render (3 reached badges); clicking opens milestone-card-modal with milestone-canvas + share/download buttons. change-avatar-button visible on /me. JoinModal on /j/j4atawQ7lw exposes avatar-upload-trigger and avatar-file-input. SSE real-time: opening /t/puntland and triggering a join via a separate requests.Session produced an in-page toast 'TEST_SSE_UI · Dubai just joined the chain' and counter updates without refresh. Regression: prior iteration 1 tests still pass (13/13).

issues: Radix DialogContent still missing DialogTitle/Description — accessibility console warning (non-blocking, same as iteration 1).

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to MilestoneCard and other dialogs to resolve Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: SSE endpoint uses in-process pub/sub via defaultdict of queues — works for single-worker MVP but will not broadcast across multiple uvicorn workers or replicas. Fine for now; document for scale-out.

publish() calls compute_stats after every join, which runs 2 count_documents + distinct queries per subscriber fan-out. At high write volume consider throttling stats emission (e.g. debounce to 500ms) — currently emits per-join.

get_avatar reads bytes via requests.get in a sync call inside async endpoint (blocks event loop). Acceptable for small avatars behind Cache-Control:3600 but consider aiohttp or offloading to threadpool.
Avatar upload path binds by device cookie only — a shared device (family/kiosk) can overwrite anyone's avatar joined from that device. Acceptable trade-off given anonymous model.
OrganizerDashboard polls /analytics every 8s in addition to SSE — could subscribe to SSE stats events instead to reduce load.
test_credentials: No auth. Flagship tartan 'puntland'; initiator share 'j4atawQ7lw' (Amina).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created a handful of TEST_ members on puntland (TEST_NonInit, TEST_Avatar, TEST_AvOwn, TEST_SSE, TEST_SSE_UI). Not cleaned up; harmless for regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run new tests via `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration2.py -v` (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env fallback). SSE test uses threading + requests stream, reads until 3 events observed. For frontend SSE verification, open /t/puntland, then in a separate requests.Session POST /api/tartans/puntland/join — an on-screen toast appears within ~2s (sonner). Avatar ownership relies on the httponly `td` cookie; a fresh requests.Session gets a new cookie and therefore 403 on /members/{share}/avatar.
